  PROBLEM: The new idle sweep step has no continue-on-error directive, so a sweep failure can fail the idle poll job and skip the following worktree registry GC step.
  WHY: The poller runs under set -euo pipefail, and the sibling idle-tick step sets continue-on-error because staging may leave a partial scripts directory.

  PROBLEM: _standalone_sweep_alert_level_apply validates the requested alert level with a case-sensitive regex, rejecting lowercase values.
  WHY: Lowercase values such as warning are rejected and the all-smoke SILENT level remains in effect; severity disagreement: one reviewer rated this MAJOR and others rated it NIT.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:27400-27610 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna]
  PROBLEM: The alert-level override applies to smoke-test PRs in the standalone conflict sweep, which does not exclude them, and can produce an extra WARNING or ERROR alert.
  WHY: A smoke PR with a persistent conflict or stalled no-op gate can alert while the release gate expects exactly one Telegram message.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1242-1255 | severity=high | confidence=[5]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, openai_gpt-6-luna, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new idle sweep step omits ALLOW_WORKFLOW_EDITS, so the poller defaults it to true instead of honoring a repository's explicit false setting.
  WHY: An idle-tick conflict dispatch can then allow workflow edits despite the repository's opt-out.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1234-1266 | severity=high | confidence=[3]
  flagged_by: [anthropic_claude-sonnet-5_5, google_gemini-3_1-flash-lite, minimax_minimax-m3, qwen_qwen3_7-plus]
  PROBLEM: The new idle sweep step has no operator kill switch despite running write actions on every idle cron tick.
  WHY: Operators cannot disable the idle-tick dispatch or merge behavior without editing the workflow; severity disagreement: one reviewer rated this NIT and others rated it MAJOR.
- .github/workflows/orchestrate_poll.yml:1255-1261 | severity=low | confidence=[4]
  flagged_by: [minimax_minimax-m3]
  PROBLEM: The staged-support guard exits successfully when the staged poller is missing or lacks the new mode, without emitting a structured signal.
  WHY: A consumer pinned to an older support commit can silently skip the new sweep indefinitely.
